meta.title: Gross farmer income per person by crop, per province (portfolio risk, objective #1)
meta.sort: crops and provinces both lowest-gross-per-person-first (floor-risk lens)

measured: Yield (kg/rai): OAE — https://catalog.oae.go.th. Rice per-province (77); maize/cassava/rubber/oil palm national.

Farm-gate price (THB/kg, rice reconciled from THB/ton): NABC Agricultural Data Service (agriapi.nabc.go.th) — daily market prices, national average across quoting markets, pulled by pipeline/pull_nabc_prices.py (REACHABLE from a Thai IP and from cloud runners; verified live 2026-07-12).
Planted area (rai, converted from DOAE hectares ×6.25): DOAE farmer_all webservice (farmer.doae.go.th), no key
Farmer-family (household) counts: NABC Agricultural Data Service (agriapi.nabc.go.th) — farmer-family + land-use; OAE-sourced, cloud-reachable, no key.
rai_per_farm and gross_per_farm_year are pure products of the above — measured.
estimated: ESTIMATED — 1.6 agricultural workers per farm household, the midpoint of the NSO agricultural-household range (~1.5-2 workers/holding; NSO Agricultural Census 2013 / Labour Force Survey). This is the ONLY estimated leg of the per-person figure; per-farm figures are fully measured.

For maize/cassava/rubber/oil palm the yield is the NATIONAL figure applied to every province (OAE publishes no machine-readable per-province yield for them); each such row is tagged yield_source="national". Rice rows are yield_source="measured".
not_computed: NET income — OAE cost-of-production per rai is PDF-only (dead end). This is GROSS farm revenue per person, an income-ceiling read, NOT take-home pay.

gaps: sugarcane — no OAE yield dataset (per-province is PDF-only); EXCLUDED.
oilpalm — planted area, yield and farm-gate price are present, but NABC farmer_family carries no 'ปาล์มน้ำมัน' household count, so gross income PER FARM cannot be computed; EXCLUDED.
caveats: GROSS revenue per person, not net and not take-home wage — no cost of production is deducted (OAE cost/rai is PDF-only).
Per-person divides per-farm gross by a single estimated workers/farm constant (1.6); adjust meta.workers_per_farm to re-scale.
Non-rice yields are national applied to province (yield_source="national"): province spread reflects area/family differences, not real yield variation.
Farm-gate price is a national daily average, not a per-province price.
A farm household is often counted under more than one crop; single-crop revenue here is per registered crop-holding, not a whole-household total.
